content: Individuals with diabetes are at an increased risk of developing lipid abnormalities and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). Research has demonstrated that the use of statin therapy can significantly lower this risk. Specifically, for every 39 mg/dL reduction in low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol achieved through statin therapy, there is an approximate 9% decrease in the risk of ASCVD.
